result.topic_en: Draft notes on the convergence and representability of a function by a trigonometric series, using the twice-integrated series F(x), its second symmetric difference quotient, and the Dirichlet-type integral for partial sums.

methods.what: Twice term-by-term integrated series F(x) of the trigonometric series
Mixed second difference quotient of F converges to the sum of the series
Second symmetric difference quotient (Schwarz/Riemann second derivative)
Integral representation with squared Dirichlet-type kernel

methods.quote: $\int_a^b dx = \int_a^b f_1 x\, dx + \int_a^b f_2 x\, dx + \int_a^b f_3 x\, dx \ldots$

items.quote: Zur Convergenz einer Reihe ist nothwendig, dass ihre Glieder mit wachsendem Index [-...-] unendlich klein werden.
items.english: For convergence of a series it is necessary that its terms become infinitely small with increasing index.

items.quote: Wir scheiden nun zuvörderst den Fall, wo die Glieder für jeden Werth von x unendlich klein werden, von demjenigen, wo dies nur für besondere Werthe von x stattfindet.
items.english: We first separate the case where the terms become infinitely small for every value of x from that where this happens only for particular values of x.

items.quote: Falls die Reihe $\Omega$ convergirt, convergirt ... gegen denselben Werth, wie die Reihe.
items.english: If the series Omega converges, the difference quotient converges, as alpha and beta become infinitely small with finite ratio, to the same value as the series.

items.quote: Diess ist aber zur Darstellbarkeit nicht hinreichend
items.english: This is however not sufficient for representability.

items.quote: es bleibt also noch zu untersuchen, welche Eigenschaften die Function Fx haben muss
items.english: It remains to investigate what properties the function F(x) must have.

items.quote: Unsere Aufgabe ist {+die Bedingungen aufzusuchen für die Richtigkeit der Gleichung+}.
items.english: Our task is to find the conditions for the correctness of the equation.

items.quote: Damit diese Gleichung stattfindet, ist [-offenbar-] nothwendig, dass der Beitrag [-jedes-] Intervalles, in [-...-] welches (einschliesslich der Grenzwerthe) der Werth x nicht fällt, mit wachsendem n unendlich klein werde
items.english: For this equation to hold it is necessary that the contribution of an interval not containing x (including endpoints) become infinitely small as n grows.
